steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the tenant.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and avoid publish being greyed out.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute event duration; the separate evaluation-duration requirement is not expressible by this step.

args.goal: add one Required Terms and Conditions clause to the event and stop with the clause visibly saved on the create screen

steps.note: Handle the required T&C clause, for which no dedicated catalog step exists.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for the two required bids without inventing supplier names.
Publish the completed PR-originated RFQ.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Submit the first vendor's portal quote at 100.
Verify that the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's portal quote at 90, representing Vendor B's lower bid.
Verify that the second vendor bid was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end so Master QCS and awarding are available.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify that both responding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Verify that the lower bid is ranked first.
Allocate the full event to the lowest-ranked vendor and submit the award proposal.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for PR to PO processing

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal when the run's buyer is the pending approver; a separate approver login is not supported.
Complete PO creation from the approved award.
Verify that one PO contains the awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Navigate to the events list to inspect the event's history entry.
Open the History tab requested by the case.
Verify that the completed event appears in event history.
Assert that the In Progress requisition view is rendered; the final Ordered status itself is not exposed by a dedicated catalog assertion.
